description: The plot illustrates ASR values across different trigger-word insertion positions for the AGNews dataset with clean-label poisoning, with the title “AGNews, clean-label, poison_rate: 10% (2.5% of total).” The x-axis is categorical with labels (left to right) “cf,” “bb,” “WNBA,” “ESPN,” “NHL,” “FIFA,” “Estadio,” and “athletics,” shown at evenly spaced positions. The y-axis is labeled “ASR,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from about 0.5 up to just under 1.0, with visible tick labels at approximately 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, and 0.9. Three lines are shown: the “start” series is a green solid line with small circular markers, starting near 0.77 at “cf,” dropping to about 0.49 at “bb,” rising to about 0.90 at “WNBA,” then moving around the low-to-mid 0.8s through “ESPN” and “NHL,” reaching about 0.88 at “FIFA,” increasing to about 0.92 at “Estadio,” and ending around 0.94 at “athletics.” The “random” series is an orange solid line with x-shaped markers, starting near 0.65 at “cf,” dipping to about 0.51 at “bb,” rising to about 0.88 at “WNBA,” dropping to about 0.72 at “ESPN,” then increasing through about 0.76 at “NHL” and about 0.88 at “FIFA,” reaching about 0.93 at “Estadio,” and ending near 0.87 at “athletics.” The “end” series is a purple solid line with circular markers, starting near 0.75 at “cf,” dropping to about 0.57 at “bb,” rising to about 0.88 at “WNBA,” dropping to about 0.74 at “ESPN,” rising to about 0.89 at “NHL,” dipping to about 0.81 at “FIFA,” peaking near 0.97 at “Estadio,” and ending around 0.83 at “athletics.”
